messages.content: You are a BPMN 2.0 modelling expert. Produce a complete BPMN 2.0 XML model for the process described by the user. Output ONLY the XML, nothing else.

The intake workflow starts with a notice by telephone at the secretarial office of the mental health care institute. This notice is done by the family doctor of somebody who is in need of mental treatment. The secretarial worker inquires after the name and residence of the patient. On the basis of this information, the doctor is put through to the nursing officer responsible for the part of the region that the patient lives in. The nursing officer makes a full inquiry into the mental, health, and social state of the patient in question. This information is recorded on a registration form. At the end of the conversation, this form is handed in at the secretarial office of the institute. Here, the information on the form is stored in the information system and subsequently printed. For new patients, a patient file is created. The registration form as well as the print from the information system are stored in the patient file. Patient files are kept at the secretarial office and may not leave the building. At the secretarial office, two registration cards are produced for respectively the future first and second intaker of the patient. The registration card contains a set of basic patient data. The new patient is added on the list of new notices. Halfway the week, at Wednesday, a staff meeting of the entire medical team takes place. The medical team consists of social-medical workers, physicians, and a psychiatrist. At this meeting, the team-leader assigns all new patients on the list of new notices to members of the team. Each patient will be assigned to a social-medical worker, who will act as the first intaker of the patient. One of the physicians will act as the second intaker. In assigning intakers, the teamleader takes into account their expertise, the region they are responsible for, earlier contacts they might have had with the patient, and their case load. The assignments are recorded on an assignment list which is handed to the secretarial office. For each new assignment, it is also determined whether the medical file of the patient is required. This information is added to the assignment list. The secretarial office stores the assignment of each patient of the assignment list in the information system. It passes the produced registration cards to the first and second intaker of each newly assigned patient. An intaker keeps this registration with him at times when visiting the patient and in his close proximity when he is at the office. For each patient for which the medical file is required, the secretarial office prepares and sends a letter to the family doctor of the patient, requesting for a copy of the medical file. As soon as this copy is received, the secretarial office will inform the second intaker and add the copy to the patient file. The first intaker plans a meeting with the patient as soon as this is possible. During the first meeting, the patient is examined using a standard checklist which is filled out. Additional observations are registered in a personal notebook. After a visit, the first intaker puts a copy of these notes in the file of a patient. The standard checklist is also added to the patient's file. The second intaker plans the first meeting only after the medical information of the physician if required has been received. Physicians use dictaphones to record their observations made during meetings with patients. The secretarial office types out these tapes, after which the information is added to the patient file. As soon as the meetings of the first and second intaker with the patient have taken place, the secretarial office puts the patient on the list of patients that reach this status. For the staff meeting on Wednesday, they provide the team-leader with a list of these patients. For each of these patients, the first and second intaker together with the team-leader and the attending psychiatrist formulate a treatment plan. This treatment plan formally ends the intake procedure.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_1"
                  targetNamespace="http://bpmn.org/schema/bpmn"
                  exporter="Camunda Modeler"
                  exporterVersion="5.0.0">

  <!-- COLLABORATION -->
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_1">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Institute" name="Mental Health Care Institute" processRef="Process_Intake" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_FamilyDoctor" name="Family Doctor" />
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Patient" name="Patient" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Notice" name="Notice by phone" sourceRef="Participant_FamilyDoctor" targetRef="StartEvent_NoticeReceived" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ReqLetter" name="Request for medical file" sourceRef="Task_SendFileReqLetter" targetRef="Participant_FamilyDoctor" />
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RecFile" name="Copy of medical file" sourceRef="Participant_FamilyDoctor" targetRef="Event_MedicalFileReceived" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <!-- PROCESS -->
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Intake" isExecutable="false">

    <!-- LANES -->
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_1">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Secretariat" name="Secretarial Office">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>StartEvent_NoticeReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InquireNameResidence</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TransferToNursingOfficer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StoreAndPrintForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ExclusiveGateway_NewPatient</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreatePatientFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ExclusiveGateway_MergeFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StoreFormAndPrintInFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProduceRegCards</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddToListOfNewNotices</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StoreAssignments</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PassRegCards</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ExclusiveGateway_FileRequired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendFileReqLetter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_MedicalFileReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_InformSecondIntaker</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ExclusiveGateway_MergeFileReq</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TypeOutTapes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AddTapeNotesToFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PutOnCompletedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvideCompletedList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_NursingOfficer" name="Nursing Officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FullInquiryState</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_HandInRegistrationForm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_MedicalTeam" name="Medical Team / Team Leader">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_WednesdayMeeting</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignIntakers</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FormulateTreatmentPlan</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EndEvent_IntakeCompleted</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_FirstIntaker" name="First Intaker (Social-Medical Worker)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlanMeeting1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExaminePatientChecklist</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterPersonalNotes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StoreNotesAndChecklistInFile</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_SecondIntaker" name="Second Intaker (Physician)">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PlanMeeting2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ExaminePatientPhysician</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RecordDictaphoneNotes</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <!-- START EVENT -->
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_NoticeReceived" name="Notice received by phone">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_1" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <!-- SECRETARIAT INTAKE FLOW -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NoticeReceived" targetRef="Task_InquireNameResidence" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InquireNameResidence" name="Inquire patient name and residence">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_InquireNameResidence" targetRef="Task_TransferToNursingOfficer" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TransferToNursingOfficer" name="Put through to regional nursing officer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- NURSING OFFICER FLOW -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_TransferToNursingOfficer" targetRef="Task_FullInquiryState" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FullInquiryState" name="Inquire into patient state & record on form">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_FullInquiryState" targetRef="Task_HandInRegistrationForm" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_HandInRegistrationForm" name="Hand in registration form at secretariat">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- SECRETARIAT PROCESSING -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_HandInRegistrationForm" targetRef="Task_StoreAndPrintForm" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StoreAndPrintForm" name="Store form data in system and print">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_StoreAndPrintForm" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_NewPatient" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_NewPatient" name="Is new patient?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NewPatient_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NewPatient_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NewPatient_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_NewPatient" targetRef="Task_CreatePatientFile" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CreatePatientFile" name="Create new patient file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NewPatient_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NewPatient_No" name="No" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_NewPatient" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFile" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFile">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NewPatient_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CreatePatientFile" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFile" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFile" targetRef="Task_StoreFormAndPrintInFile" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StoreFormAndPrintInFile" name="Store registration form & print in patient file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_StoreFormAndPrintInFile" targetRef="Task_ProduceRegCards" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProduceRegCards" name="Produce two registration cards">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRegCards" targetRef="Task_AddToListOfNewNotices" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddToListOfNewNotices" name="Add new patient to list of new notices">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- STAFF MEETING ASSIGNMENTS -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_AddToListOfNewNotices" targetRef="Event_WednesdayMeeting" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_WednesdayMeeting" name="Wednesday staff meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_1" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Event_WednesdayMeeting" targetRef="Task_AssignIntakers" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AssignIntakers" name="Assign intakers & determine medical file requirement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_AssignIntakers" targetRef="Task_StoreAssignments" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StoreAssignments" name="Store assignments in information system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_StoreAssignments" targetRef="Task_PassRegCards" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PassRegCards" name="Pass registration cards to 1st and 2nd intakers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- PARALLEL PATHS FOR INTAKERS & FILE REQUEST -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_PassRegCards" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_FileRequired" />
    
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_FileRequired" name="Is medical file required?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FileReq_Yes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FileReq_No</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <!-- Path 1: Medical File Required -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileReq_Yes" name="Yes" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_FileRequired" targetRef="Task_SendFileReqLetter" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendFileReqLetter" name="Prepare and send request letter to family doctor">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FileReq_Yes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_SendFileReqLetter" targetRef="Event_MedicalFileReceived" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MedicalFileReceived" name="Receive copy of medical file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_2" />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Event_MedicalFileReceived" targetRef="Task_InformSecondIntaker" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_InformSecondIntaker" name="Inform 2nd intaker & add copy to patient file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_InformSecondIntaker" targetRef="Task_PlanMeeting2" />

    <!-- Path 2: Medical File Not Required -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FileReq_No" name="No" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_FileRequired" targetRef="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFileReq" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFileReq">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FileReq_No</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="ExclusiveGateway_MergeFileReq" targetRef="Task_PlanMeeting2" />

    <!-- FIRST INTAKER WORKFLOW -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_PassRegCards" targetRef="Task_PlanMeeting1" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlanMeeting1" name="Plan first meeting with patient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_PlanMeeting1" targetRef="Task_ExaminePatientChecklist" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExaminePatientChecklist" name="Examine patient using standard checklist">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Task_ExaminePatientChecklist" targetRef="Task_RegisterPersonalNotes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterPersonalNotes" name="Register additional observations in notebook">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Task_RegisterPersonalNotes" targetRef="Task_StoreNotesAndChecklistInFile" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StoreNotesAndChecklistInFile" name="Put notes copy & checklist into patient file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- SECOND INTAKER WORKFLOW -->
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PlanMeeting2" name="Plan first meeting with patient">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_PlanMeeting2" targetRef="Task_ExaminePatientPhysician" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ExaminePatientPhysician" name="Examine patient during meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_ExaminePatientPhysician" targetRef="Task_RecordDictaphoneNotes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RecordDictaphoneNotes" name="Record observations on dictaphone">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_27</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_27" sourceRef="Task_RecordDictaphoneNotes" targetRef="Task_TypeOutTapes" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TypeOutTapes" name="Type out dictaphone tapes">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_27</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_28</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_28" sourceRef="Task_TypeOutTapes" targetRef="Task_AddTapeNotesToFile" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AddTapeNotesToFile" name="Add typed observations to patient file">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_28</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_29</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <!-- WRAP-UP & TREATMENT PLAN -->
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_StoreNotesAndChecklistInFile" targetRef="Task_PutOnCompletedList" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_29" sourceRef="Task_AddTapeNotesToFile" targetRef="Task_PutOnCompletedList" />

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PutOnCompletedList" name="Put patient on list of completed meetings">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_29</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_30</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_30" sourceRef="Task_PutOnCompletedList" targetRef="Task_ProvideCompletedList" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvideCompletedList" name="Provide team-leader with completed list for Wednesday meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_30</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_31</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_31" sourceRef="Task_ProvideCompletedList" targetRef="Task_FormulateTreatmentPlan" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FormulateTreatmentPlan" name="Formulate treatment plan at staff meeting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_31</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_32</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_32" sourceRef="Task_FormulateTreatmentPlan" targetRef="EndEvent_IntakeCompleted" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_IntakeCompleted" name="Intake procedure completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_32</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

  </bpmn:process>

  <!-- DIAGRAM -->
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_1">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_1" bpmnElement="Collaboration_1">

      <!-- PARTICIPANTS -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant_Institute_di" bpmnElement="Participant_Institute" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="160" y="200" width="2800" height="1100" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Participant_FamilyDoctor_di" bpmnElement="Participant_FamilyDoctor" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="160" y="80" width="2800" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- LANES -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_Secretariat_di" bpmnElement="Lane_Secretariat" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="200" width="2770" height="300" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_NursingOfficer_di" bpmnElement="Lane_NursingOfficer" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="500" width="2770" height="180" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_MedicalTeam_di" bpmnElement="Lane_MedicalTeam" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="680" width="2770" height="180" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_FirstIntaker_di" bpmnElement="Lane_FirstIntaker" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="860" width="2770" height="220" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Lane_SecondIntaker_di" bpmnElement="Lane_SecondIntaker" isHorizontal="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="190" y="1080" width="2770" height="220" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <!-- FLOW NODES -->
      <!-- Secretariat Nodes -->
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="StartEvent_NoticeReceived_di" bpmnElement="StartEvent_NoticeReceived">
        <dc:Bounds x="242" y="322" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="221" y="365" width="79" height="27" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_InquireNameResidence_di" bpmnElement="Task_InquireNameResidence">
        <dc:Bounds x="320" y="300" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_TransferToNursingOfficer_di" bpmnElement="Task_TransferToNursingOfficer">
        <dc:Bounds x="460" y="300" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_FullInquiryState_di" bpmnElement="Task_FullInquiryState">
        <dc:Bounds x="460" y="550" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>

      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="Task_HandInRegistrationForm_di" bpmnElement="Task_HandInRegistrationForm">
